package.name: pr2_right_arm_moveit_config
package.description: MoveIt 2 planning configuration (SRDF, kinematics, planning, controller mapping) for the P2 right-arm/right-gripper groups defined in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_PR2_MOVEIT_PICK_PLACE.md. This is example-fixture configuration for robots_worlds/pr2, not robotlens_desktop production code; it is a standalone ROS 2 package by design so its SRDF/YAML source stays reviewable and separate from the C++ desktop application.
